edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner()/manager in the privileged check.
msg.sender must equal owner() to bypass an active pause lock.
msg.sender is cast to INFTXVaultFactory and stored during initialization.
mint forwards msg.sender as the mint recipient into mintTo.
redeemTo burns shares directly from msg.sender.
swapTo charges fees against msg.sender.
receiveNFTs pulls the NFTs from msg.sender as the transfer source.
msg.sender is checked against the factory fee exclusion mapping.
transferFromERC721 uses msg.sender as the ERC721 from address.
msg.sender is passed as initiator to the external onFlashLoan callback.
block.timestamp feeds the entropy used to pick a random token id.
Randomness produced from block.timestamp is miner-influenceable.
mint delegates execution to mintTo.
redeem delegates execution to redeemTo.
swap delegates execution to swapTo.
mintTo calls receiveNFTs to pull the deposited NFTs.
mintTo charges and distributes the mint fee.
redeemTo calls withdrawNFTsTo to send NFTs out.
redeemTo charges redeem fees before withdrawal.
swapTo withdraws requested NFTs before receiving new ones.
swapTo calls receiveNFTs for the incoming NFTs.
swapTo charges swap fees to the caller.
flashLoan enforces the pause lock before lending.
flashLoan mints tokens then invokes receiver.onFlashLoan.
receiveNFTs validates eligibility through allValidNFTs.
receiveNFTs pulls ERC721 tokens with transferFromERC721.
withdrawNFTsTo invokes the eligibility afterRedeemHook.
withdrawNFTsTo sends ERC721 tokens out with transferERC721.
withdrawNFTsTo picks random token ids when fewer specific ids are given.
afterRedeemHook reads the configured eligibility storage address.
initializer enables all features by calling setVaultFeatures.
setVaultMetadata is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
setVaultFeatures is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
setFees is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
disableVaultFees is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
deployEligibilityStorage is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
setManager is guarded by the onlyPrivileged check.
mintTo applies the mint pause lock.
redeemTo applies the redeem pause lock.
swapTo applies the swap pause lock.
setFees writes fees through vaultFactory.setVaultFees.
disableVaultFees calls vaultFactory.disableVaultFees.
deployEligibilityStorage reads the eligibility manager from the factory.
fee charging reads the distributor and exclusion data from the factory.
mintFee reads vaultFees from the factory.
vaultFees proxies to the factory vaultFees getter.
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads vaultFactory.isLocked for the lock id.
receiveNFTs performs an ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom that calls back into the sender.
withdrawNFTsTo performs ERC1155 safeTransferFrom callbacks before completing bookkeeping.
_chargeAndDistributeFees transfers tokens then calls the distributor, which can reenter.
transferERC721 executes an unchecked low-level call to the asset contract.
transferFromERC721 executes low-level staticcall/call to the asset contract.
swapTo sums user supplied ERC1155 amounts into count for fee computation.
redeemTo combines fee rates with amount and specificIds.length arithmetically.
receiveNFTs accumulates deposited quantities in quantity1155.
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 for each withdrawn ERC1155 token.
mintTo recipient parameter flows into the share minting call.
redeemTo amount parameter drives the share burn amount.
redeemTo specificIds parameter drives fee computation and withdrawal.
swapTo tokenIds parameter is fed back into receiveNFTs.
swapTo amounts parameter is summed for the swap fee.
swapTo count accumulator is the value used in fee arithmetic.
redeemTo totalFee local holds the computed fee value.
receiveNFTs tokenIds parameter drives the transfer and holdings updates.
receiveNFTs amounts parameter drives quantity1155 accumulation.
receiveNFTs count local aggregates ERC1155 amount bookkeeping.
withdrawNFTsTo amount parameter bounds the withdrawal loop.
withdrawNFTsTo specificIds parameter selects target tokens.
withdrawNFTsTo to parameter is the transfer destination.
withdrawNFTsTo loop tokenId indexes the quantity1155 decrement.
flashLoan receiver parameter is the callback target.
flashLoan amount parameter determines minted and burned tokens.
randomIndex local is produced from block derived entropy.
_chargeAndDistributeFees user parameter receives the fee transfer source.
_chargeAndDistributeFees amount parameter is transferred to the distributor.
receiveNFTs inserts and updates the holdings set.
withdrawNFTsTo removes token ids from the holdings set.
nftIdAt reads a token id from the holdings set.
receiveNFTs increments quantity1155 entries.
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 entries.
is1155 flag selects the ERC1155 branch and count logic in swapTo.
assetAddress is the transfer source for inbound NFT pulls.
assetAddress is the target of outbound NFT transfers.
initializer stores the caller as the vault factory reference.
initializer stores the vault id read from the factory.
initializer stores the asset address parameter.
initializer stores the is1155 flag.
initializer stores the allowAllItems flag.
setVaultFeatures writes the enableMint flag.
setManager writes the manager state variable.
deployEligibilityStorage writes the deployed eligibility address.
deployEligibilityStorage disables allowAllItems once eligibility is set.
onlyPrivileged reads the manager state variable for authorization.
mintFee uses vaultId to query per-vault fees.
vaultFees uses vaultId to query factory fees.

redeemTo amount parameter should be collapsed into redeemTo.
redeemTo specificIds parameter should be collapsed into redeemTo.
swapTo tokenIds parameter should be collapsed into swapTo.
swapTo amounts parameter should be collapsed into swapTo.
swapTo count local is the operand of the swap fee arithmetic operation.
redeemTo totalFee local is the result of the redeem fee arithmetic operation.
receiveNFTs tokenIds parameter should be collapsed into receiveNFTs.
receiveNFTs amounts parameter should be collapsed into receiveNFTs.
receiveNFTs count local is the accumulator of the quantity1155 addition.
withdrawNFTsTo amount parameter should be collapsed into withdrawNFTsTo.
withdrawNFTsTo specificIds parameter should be collapsed into withdrawNFTsTo.
withdrawNFTsTo to parameter should be collapsed into withdrawNFTsTo.
withdrawNFTsTo loop tokenId drives the quantity1155 subtraction.
flashLoan receiver parameter should be collapsed into flashLoan.
flashLoan amount parameter should be collapsed into flashLoan.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault randomIndex local is the weak randomness result.
_chargeAndDistributeFees user parameter should be collapsed into the fee function.
_chargeAndDistributeFees amount parameter should be collapsed into the fee function.
